## About
AutoCorrect is a family owned and operated repair shop on Maxwell Road in Alpharetta. We work on Japanese and domestic vehicles, whether you need a simple oil change or want us to track down that rattling sound you can't quite place.
Our goal is to give you dealership quality parts and maintenance at a fraction of the cost. We'd also like to help you learn how to care for your car, so you spend less on repairs over time.
Customers often mention Joe by name, and they say we take the time to explain what's going on with their car. We're grateful for a 4.9 rating from 42 Google reviews.

## Services
- Brakes: Diagnosis and repair for brake problems, including rotors, pads and shoes, brake cleaning and brake replacement.
- Air conditioning: Help with air conditioning trouble and refrigerant leaks, which can damage your evaporator and compressor if left alone.
- Alignment: If your car pulls to one side, an alignment check helps it handle better and drive smoothly.
- Check engine light: If your check engine light comes on and stays on, even after service, we can track down emission control problems and get you back on the road.
- Engine work: Engine repair and replacement, belt and hose replacement, performance checks, plus fuel injection, fuel system and ignition system service.
- Maintenance: Tune ups, oil changes, fluid services, filter replacements, inspections and factory scheduled maintenance to help your car last.
- Transmission: New and rebuilt transmissions, axle replacement, clutch repair and replacement, and differential service and repair.

## FAQ
Q: What vehicles do you work on?
A: We specialize in Japanese and domestic vehicles, and we now have a BMW specialist on-site.

Q: Can I drop my car off outside business hours?
A: Yes. We have a drop available, so you can leave your car with us even when the shop is closed.

Q: Do I need an appointment?
A: You can call to schedule, or stop in during business hours and talk with an ASE certified technician.

Q: Is there somewhere to wait while my car is serviced?
A: Yes. You're welcome to use our internet cafe while we work on your vehicle.
